senses.gloss: [स्तु 2. STU, drop, be clotted: in stuka, 🞄stúkā, and stoká].
स्तुक stuka, m. tuft of hair.
स्तुका stú-kā, f. tuft or hair, lock of wool, 🞄curly hair on a bullʼs forehead (V.): -vín, 🞄a. shaggy (RV.¹).

स्तुत् stú-t, a. (—˚) praising;
 f. (V.) (hymn 🞄of) praise.

स्तुत stu-tá, pp. √ stu;
 n. praise: -śastrá, 🞄n. du. Stotra and Śastra.

स्तुत्य stu-tya, fp. to be praised, praiseworthy;
 🞄-tva, n. praiseworthiness.
स्तुप stupá, m. tuft of hair (V.).
